summary: A fresh real-BB pass confirmed the final rail-free Host Monitor 0.1.2 UI: page cards/rows and compact/floating hosts have no tone-colored edge, background, border, or shadow; Critical and Needs attention retain readable semantic text and dots while Healthy text is neutral; page host buttons open neutral Radix explanations on hover/focus; compact rows remain native focusable list items with safe described explanations and neutral hover/focus feedback, including upward placement for the final or only host. BB's global Host Monitor icon stayed neutral with no notification pseudo-element. Executable cases cover offline, disconnected, sampling, stale, failed-refresh, unavailable, malformed state/alert, and malicious raw-error fallbacks absent from the live fleet.
